name: Student Marketplace
short: A university-focused space for products, bike rentals, lost and found, and student services.
problem: Students need a convenient way to discover products, rentals, lost items, and useful services within their university community.
solution: A university marketplace that brings these needs into a shared digital space.

name: ProFix
short: A home service booking platform designed around finding help and arranging a service.
problem: Finding and arranging a home service can involve disconnected searches and conversations.
solution: A home service booking platform that connects service discovery with a clear booking experience.

name: Supermarket Information System
short: An academic information system using C# and MySQL to explore business data and application development.
problem: Supermarket information needs to be organised and made accessible through a structured system.
solution: A C# application supported by a MySQL database.

name: Student Performance Analytics
short: Exploring student performance through statistical analysis and presenting meaningful findings.
problem: Student performance data needs to be examined carefully to understand relationships between variables.
solution: Statistical analysis using SPSS, with results presented through clear summaries and visualisations.

name: House Service Booking System
short: A location-based service booking concept that helps people discover relevant home services.
problem: People looking for home services need to find options relevant to their location.
solution: A booking system with location-based service discovery.

name: Rocket Landing Simulation
short: A C# console application exploring control flow and the logic behind a simulated rocket landing.
problem: A rocket landing scenario provides a practical way to explore programming decisions and simulation logic.
solution: A console-based rocket landing simulation written in C#.
